BEGIN;
    CREATE TABLE t1(w int, x int, y int, z int);

CREATE TABLE t1(x TEXT, y TEXT COLLATE nocase);
  INSERT INTO t1 VALUES('0', 'abc');
SELECT x                BETWEEN 1 AND '5'" FROM t1
SELECT x COLLATE binary BETWEEN 1 AND '5'" FROM t1
SELECT x COLLATE nocase BETWEEN 1 AND '5'" FROM t1
SELECT y                  BETWEEN 'A' AND 'B'" FROM t1
SELECT y COLLATE nocase   BETWEEN 'A' AND 'B'" FROM t1
SELECT y COLLATE binary   BETWEEN 'A' AND 'B'" FROM t1
SELECT (y COLLATE binary) BETWEEN 'A' AND 'B'" FROM t1
SELECT * FROM t1 LEFT JOIN t2 ON (x BETWEEN 1 AND 3);
SELECT * FROM t1 LEFT JOIN t2 ON (x BETWEEN 5 AND 7);
